Of course, I'd be happy to help! The sequence seven eight is associated with the "Miller's Magic Number" or "The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two" theory, proposed by George Miller in 1956. This theory suggests that the human short-term memory can hold approximately 7 ± 2 items. It's an important concept in cognitive psychology, particularly in understanding memory capacity and organization.

A good resource for further reading could be Miller's original paper titled "The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two: Some Limits on Our Capacity for Processing Information," published in Psychological Review in 1956. Enjoy your studies, and good luck with your exam!
